fields.proposed_explanation:

report_evidence.example_masked: 1 for the 20 employees paid WT 62149 in Sep-2026

fields.proposed_explanation:
Annex table 5.5.3 - a SIXTEEN-value list (01, 02, 04, 12, 18, 19, 21, 22, 23, 30, 31, 47, 51, 54, 56, 58). It is a SUBSET of the PILA tipo contributor list, which has far more values, so the engine must map, not copy: PILA codes with no DIAN equivalent (for example 03 independiente, 16, 20, 32-45, 52, 53, 55, 57, 59-63) are not valid here. Bidirectional pair with 'Apprentice maintenance support' (NIE157): where NIE157 is present this field must be worker type 12 or 19 (aprendiz).

CLIENT DATA (PMI masked reports, Sep-2026): the client holds no worker-type code. Derive it from a client-approved mapping of Master Data 'Employee Group Code' / 'Employee Subgroup Code' (e.g. Group 6 / Subgroup E2 = the INKOMPASS interns paid WT 62149, also flagged by Accumulated WT 64116 'Apprentice formula' = 1); all other populations default to 01 only after the client confirms the mapping. fields.proposed_explanation:

CLIENT DATA (PMI masked reports, Sep-2026): the client stores no document-type code; Master Data holds one column per document (AP 'Citizenship Card ID', AO 'Indentity Card for Foreigners', AN 'Identity Card', AM 'National ID'). Derive the code from the column used: Citizenship Card ID -> 13, Identity Card for Foreigners -> 22. 'Identity Card' and 'National ID' need a client-confirmed code. Several employees have more than one column filled; a client-approved precedence rule is needed so that one document type is reported, and the same one in NIE044 and NIE045.

fields.name: Employee document number
fields.finding: G2N 'National ID' holds the citizenship card number only and is blank for 14 employees, all foreign nationals whose only document is in Master Data 'Indentity Card for Foreigners' (6-7 characters). Taking G2N 'National ID' alone would leave 14 documents empty. Foreigner-card examples have a leading zero in the masked copy; masking substitutes digits, so whether the raw values have leading zeros (lost under xsd:integer) must be checked by Wallisson locally on the raw file.
fields.proposed_explanation:
Identity document number without dots or hyphens. It is input [8] to the CUNE and the join key to Form 220 and Format 2276. CO-GAP-07 - KNOWN SCHEMA DEFECT: the XSD types this attribute as xsd:integer, so a passport or foreign identity document containing letters (document types 21, 41, 42, 50) cannot be schema-valid. DIAN has published no workaround; escalate per client.

CLIENT DATA (PMI masked reports, Sep-2026): take the number from the same Master Data column that set NIE044 (AP 'Citizenship Card ID', AO 'Indentity Card for Foreigners', AN 'Identity Card', AM 'National ID'). Do not use G2N 'National ID' alone: it is blank for the 14 foreign employees, whose only document is the foreigners' card. Strip dots and hyphens. Check whether foreigners' card numbers have leading zeros, which xsd:integer drops and which would then not match the CUNE input [8].
fields.official_source: XSD v1.0.6 (NumeroDocumento xsd:integer); Technical Annex s.8.1.1.1

fields.name: All-inclusive salary flag

report_evidence.column: E Monthly Basic Salary and Integral Salary

fields.finding: No integral-salary flag in Master Data. The only discriminator is the salary wage type: 62140 Integral Salary vs 62100 Ordinary Salary. Health/pension deductions of the 62140 group are 2.8% of WT 64990 (4% of 70%), confirming the 70% rule. Base of Withholding mixes both in one column.
fields.proposed_explanation:
Whether the employee is on an all-inclusive salary under CST art. 132 num. 2 (minimum 13 SMMLV = COP 22,761,765 in 2026, of which 70% is salary and 30% is the prestacional factor). Where true, the contribution base is 70% of the integral salary and no separate prima, cesantias or interest accrues - which changes what may legitimately appear in the Devengados block.

CLIENT DATA (PMI masked reports, Sep-2026): the client has no flag field. Set true where the employee's salary wage type is 62140 'Integral Salary- 0423' (Accumulated also has 62141 'Arrears-Integral Salary'); false where it is 62100 'Ordinary Salary- 0003'. In Sep-2026: 88 integral, 153 ordinary, 20 interns (62149, neither).

Proposed Query to RA: Client to provide the contract term per employee (table 5.5.2), and confirm whether the INKOMPASS interns hold apprenticeship contracts (4) or internships (5).
fields.proposed_explanation:
Annex table 5.5.2: 1 Fixed term, 2 Indefinite term, 3 Obra o Labor, 4 Aprendizaje, 5 Practicas o Pasantias. Law 2466 of 2025 art. 21 recast the apprenticeship as a labour contract, so code 4 now denotes a genuine employment relationship. Bidirectional pair with 'Apprentice maintenance support' (NIE157): where NIE157 is present this field must be contract type 4 (aprendizaje).

CLIENT DATA (PMI masked reports, Sep-2026): Master Data 'Employment Contract Type' holds 'WM' for all 261 employees, including the 20 interns (Group 6 / Subgroup E2) paid WT 62149. It does not carry the term of the contract. A client-supplied source for the table 5.5.2 code is required (fixed / indefinite / obra o labor / aprendizaje / practicas); until then this mandatory field cannot be filled.

CLIENT DATA (PMI masked reports, Sep-2026): the client holds three dates - Master Data 'Hire Date' (= G2N 'Hire Date'), 'Original Hire Date' and 'Adjusted Service Date' - which differ for 40 / 21 employees (rehires and transfers). fields.name: Time worked
fields.finding: Cumulative service depends on which start date is used (see NIE002): for a rehire, Hire Date 02-04-2025 gives about 1.5 years, Adjusted Service Date 2019-07-02 about 7 years.
fields.proposed_explanation:
COMPOSITE VALUE - construction rule. Cumulative service with the employer expressed in DAYS on the Colombian commercial-year convention fixed by Technical Annex s.8.3.1: 1 year = 360 days, 1 month = 30 days. The annex's own worked example is 5 years + 3 months + 18 days = (5 x 360) + (3 x 30) + 18 = 1908.00. Sub-fields: [years x 360] + [months x 30] + [odd days]. PERSISTENCE: recomputed every month from FechaIngreso (NIE002) to the settlement end; it is cumulative service, NOT days worked in the period (that is DiasTrabajados, NIE069).

CLIENT DATA (PMI masked reports, Sep-2026): compute from the date confirmed for NIE002 (Hire Date vs Original Hire Date vs Adjusted Service Date - they differ for up to 40 employees); never mix two dates between NIE002 and this field.

fields.name: Days worked

report_evidence.column: WT Code 63812 'Worked Days Current Month Without Leaves'

fields.finding: G2N has no day count. The Accumulated Report carries 63812 'Worked Days Current Month Without Leaves' and 63953 'Total SSI days'. For employees on vacation the client cuts WT 62100 and pays the vacation days in 79401 (salary + vacation = contractual salary), so days worked must exclude the vacation days to stay consistent with NIE070.
fields.proposed_explanation:
Days actually worked and paid in the period, on the 30-day commercial month. Distinct from TiempoLaborado (NIE006), which is cumulative service. Reduced by unpaid leave, by suspension and by a mid-month hire or leave.

CLIENT DATA (PMI masked reports, Sep-2026): candidate source = Accumulated WT 63812 'Worked Days Current Month Without Leaves' for the month (not 63953 'Total SSI days', which is the PILA day count). The client reduces WT 62100/62140 for vacation days and pays them in 79401, so the days reported here must be the days paid under NIE070 only. Client to confirm 63812 as the source.

fields.name: Salary paid for the period

The client also pays salary arrears (62101/62141); the explanation does not say whether arrears go into SueldoTrabajado or elsewhere. Proposed Query to RA: Client to confirm where salary arrears (WT 62101 / 62141) are reported: SueldoTrabajado of the payment month, or another element.
fields.proposed_explanation:
The basic salary actually earned for the days worked. Moves with DiasTrabajados; contrast Sueldo (NIE062), which is the static contractual figure. This is the single largest input to the ET art. 388 depurated withholding base and to the PILA contribution base.

CLIENT DATA (PMI masked reports, Sep-2026): sum WT 62100 'Ordinary Salary- 0003' and WT 62140 'Integral Salary- 0423'. Vacation days are excluded by the client (paid in 79401 -> NIE112). Salary arrears 62101 'Arrears - Ordinary salary' and 62141 'Arrears-Integral Salary' (Accumulated) need a client decision: in this element or as a separate concept. WT 62149 (intern support) does not belong here (-> NIE157).

fields.name: Transport allowance

report_evidence.column: G Salary Assigned of the 74 recipients

fields.finding: The client pays a 'Transportation Allowance CLA' (collective agreement) of exactly the statutory amount 249,095 to 74 employees, ALL with salaries above 2 SMMLV (4.55M-12.8M). fields.proposed_explanation:
Sum of every element in the Devengados block. Item 6 and item 8 of the art. 5 mandatory content. Input [4] to the CUNE, where it must be TRUNCATED to two decimals - truncated, not rounded, a distinction that catches many implementations. Bidirectional set with 'Rounding residual' (NIE186), which is present only where round-half-to-even rounding of the individual concepts leaves this total differing from the sum of its parts.

CLIENT DATA (PMI masked reports, Sep-2026): the client's G2N groups WTs as 'Entitlements', 'Deductions' and 'Non Cash Earnings/Deductions'. Total = all 'Entitlements' WTs mapped to Devengados elements, plus only those informative 'Non Cash' earnings explicitly mapped (NIE193 / NIE154); employer contributions and bases in the Non Cash grouping are never included. Negative Entitlement lines occur (e.g. 62216 -3,319,075; 62540 -971,899) and no element accepts a negative: the rule (net against the same concept, or report as a deduction) must be defined before build.
